en.html:
Breakfast.

The guard delivered it at precisely the appointed time. As arranged, a message had also come along with the food.

With the table knife I cut open the paper milk carton—Yamato did not yet have these in circulation. The waterproof paper pasted inside was easy to find. Shake off the moisture, unfold, read.

“Ah, Kageaki! We have pledged our love; now neither of us can manage living alone. If only we could live together in a world as quiet as two hundred million years ago, what need would we have for words?”

朝食。
　規定時刻きっかりに守衛の兵士から差し入れられた
それには、あらかじめ聞いていた通りの方法で通信が
仕込まれていた。

　大和ではまだ流通していない紙製の牛乳容器を食用
ナイフで切開すると、内側に貼られた耐水紙がすぐに
見つかる。
　水分を払ってから広げ、文章に目を通した。

『ああ、景明さま！　愛を誓ったわたくしたち二人は
もう、一人だけでは生きていられない。
　二億年前のように静かな世界で一緒に暮らせるなら、
もう言葉なんて何もいらないのに』

en.html:
—The enemy’s operation, and our response to it. Both.

I converted the romance into its proper meaning. Two hundred million years of undying love, reduced to: no change in the timetable. Haan. Intelligence work. First remove the intelligence from the sentence, then trust the recipient to put it back. An enemy could read every word and know nothing. I could also read every word and wish to know nothing, but from my side that would be neglect of duty.

Then I turned the paper over and wrote the code for “Understood in full.”
